priorReturnInThisDirectory.whatThisReturnAdds: The one-cause-or-three determination the Captain asked for, measured rather than argued: a forced-election rebuild of all three families, and the demonstration that closing ROUTE_OPTIONS' counter does not stop the clone and does not make any of these petitions state its statute.

theOneCauseOrThreeFinding.shortAnswer: One immediate cause, three different answers, and the working hypothesis in the assignment is wrong.
theOneCauseOrThreeFinding.theHypothesisTested: That New Jersey publishes one petition serving several statutory categories, that the category is chosen on the form, and that if nothing selects it every route renders the same document -- so fixing the selection would stop the clone.
theOneCauseOrThreeFinding.howItWasTested: The election was forced on in the shared East host behind an environment flag (FIX121_FORCE_ELECTION), all three families were rebuilt, the delivered bytes were digested, delivered page 19 was rastered at 150 dpi and looked at, and the completeness verifier was re-run on the forced bytes. The host edit and all three family directories were then restored with `git checkout` and every digest was recomputed and matched.

resultMeasured.counterOnForcedBytes: requiredOptionsMissing falls from 1 to 0 and the completeness verdict changes from FAIL_ROUTE_SELECTION to NOT_MEASURABLE_HERE, i.e. all nine counters read zero or unmeasured.
resultMeasured.whatThePageThenShows: Read by eye at 150 dpi: a marked X beside `d.` standing over nine wholly blank cells -- no date, no offence, no statute, no sentence, no court, no completion events. The petition then swears, under the notarised Verification on delivered page 24, that the petitioner pled or was found guilty of charges it declines to identify. It still names no statutory route.

theOneCauseOrThreeFinding.conclusion: Marking the election does NOT stop the clone. It cannot: item (d) of CN-10557 is the single conviction disposition shared by all three statutory categories, it says nothing about which section of chapter 52 the petition proceeds under, and the three families build from one persona on one form. The clone and the ROUTE_OPTIONS failure are two symptoms of the same emptiness, not cause and effect. Closing the counter here would be a green nine over a defect the family's own reader already named.

theThreeAnswers.answer: ROUTE_OPTIONS is answerable on this form and is not answerable today. CN-10557 carries exactly one control that names this family's statute: the Verification paragraph 3 checkbox `seekJuvNever` on delivered page 24, whose printed text is 'I am seeking expungement of a conviction on a criminal case or an adjudication of delinquency on a juvenile case pursuant to N.J.S.A. 2C:52-2, and I have never been granted an expungement, sealing or similar relief regarding a criminal conviction, by any state or federal court.' The kit's own instruction, delivered page 17 item 14, directs an indictable petitioner to check it. This lane did not mark it, for two reasons stated under blockers.

No control on CN-10557 states this route's statute on the ordinary pathway. Every selection control on the 43-page kit was enumerated from the family's own field census -- 19 checkboxes and 14 dropdowns -- and the only one that names 2C:52-3 is `seek5yrs` on delivered page 22, which names 2C:52-3(b)(2), the EARLY three-year pathway, and is conditional on a compelling-circumstances narrative the registry classifies as not template output. On the ordinary five-year pathway this petition has nowhere to say which section it proceeds under. If the obligation is to be satisfied at all it is satisfied by a document CN-10557 does not contain, which is a COMPONENT_SET answer and not a route-option one.

Same as disorderly persons -- no control on CN-10557 names 2C:52-4 anywhere -- plus an independent hold this family alone carries. Its own track record holds a release_blocker: 'The full text of N.J.S.A. 2C:52-4, including whether ordinance convictions count toward the offence caps on the indictable and disorderly persons tracks. The section was not obtained at an official New Jersey channel, and only the two-year period is confirmed, from the New Jersey Courts self-help page.' A route whose controlling section has never been read cannot have its statutory election settled by a build lane.

theOneCauseOrThreeFinding.whatThisMeansForStaffingTheRestOfTheFail: A ROUTE_OPTIONS failure on a shared statewide kit should be triaged by asking first whether the instrument HAS a control that names the route, before any lane is sent to make an election. Where it does not, the work is a legal-design question about the packet's component set, not a build fix, and a repair lane will return blocked however many times it is dispatched. The byte-identity finding in CLONED_FAMILY_PACKETS.json is a true observation about these three and a false lead about their cause.
theOneCauseOrThreeFinding.whatThisDoesNotDecide: It does not decide that any of the three owes a different instrument. It decides that CN-10557 alone cannot state 2C:52-3 or 2C:52-4, and names that as the question. Nothing was drafted, added to a manifest or promoted.
